content: This lexicon considers the agency attributed to subjects of nearly 2000 transitive and intransitive verbs. To use this lexicon to quantify denial of agency in our corpus, we extract all sentences' head verbs and their corresponding subjects, where the subject noun phrase contains a target group label. Unlike BIBREF22's real-valued Connotation Frames lexicon for perspective, the agency lexicon only provides binary labels, so we calculate the fraction of subject-verb pairs where a subject containing a group label was given high agency by its head verb.
